text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (P1) - continuous-batching latency spike observed on inference-prod (region-us-east-1). Alerts: vec_latency_95 > 750ms, queue_depth increasing rapidly. Caller: oncall on duty.

maria: I'm seeing a huge microbatch growth on node gpu-42, microbatch_size jumping from 2 -> 18 in 30s. KV cache evictions also spiking.

kevin: confirm metrics - eviction rate x5, tail latency up. Looks like prefill/prefix cache thrash when concurrency rises.

asha: any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy: inference-runtime v2.8.1 rolled 2h ago (canary ok). No recent config changes.

ryan: grabbing logs from runtime on that host. attaching short dump.

jordan: quick ask — can we temporarily clamp microbatching so we stop the cascade?

maria: yes. My plan: set CB_MAX_MICROBATCH=4 and CB_WINDOW_MS=10 on the affected pool, and enable batch_throttle=true. Should reduce KV churn and queueing.

kevin: agree. Also reduce prefetch depth to 1 for that pool: PREFETCH_DEPTH=1.

maria: applying patch now to pool-inference-us-east-1-gpu. Running command:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-runtime CB_MAX_MICROBATCH=4 CB_WINDOW_MS=10 PREFETCH_DEPTH=1 BATCH_THROTTLE=true
```

sre-bot: rolling update started for deployment/inference-runtime (3 pods at a time).

asha: I'll watch request latencies and eviction metrics. If this doesn't help in 2 mins we fallback to model-fallback-routing to cpu-small.

maria: patch applied on two nodes so far. Patch summary: microbatch cap, window reduced, prefetch trimmed, throttle on.

deploy-bot: rollout progressing: 2/8 pods updated (safe roll). No image change.

ryan: after first two pods updated: queue_depth down ~40%, microbatch size now averaging 3-4, eviction rate dropping. tail latency moving down.

kevin: nice. Can we also tweak continuous-batcher backpressure weight? Set CB_BACKPRESSURE_ALPHA=0.6 to bias early flush under high load.

maria: setting that as well.
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-runtime CB_BACKPRESSURE_ALPHA=0.6
```

jordan: any customer impact yet? Billing/SLAs?

asha: Customer support reported 3 customer incidents in last 15m for timeouts on large chat flows. Likely due to queueing causing request cancellations. Escalated to CS.

maria: telemetry shows 98% of requests now completing within SLO after patch on first group. I'm continuing rollout.

sre-bot: rollout continuing: 5/8 pods updated.

kevin: thumbs up. Keep an eye on token-per-request anomalies — we might be double-prefetching for some request shapes.

ryan: I see a pattern: long-prefix LLM requests (seq > 1k) trigger prefill which then blocks KV memory until next microbatch. Combined with high concurrency this causes pipeline stalls. We'll file a follow-up to add request-shape based prefetch heuristic.

maria: rollout finished: 8/8 pods updated. Post-roll stats: tail latency (p95) down from 820ms -> 230ms, eviction rate back to baseline. Queue depth stable.

deploy-bot: rollout complete.

asha: marking live mitigation successful. Next steps: postmortem, customer comms, and a short-term config guard to prevent automatic prefetch increase over threshold.

jordan: assigning follow-ups:
- ry: follow-up investigation on prefill heuristics and long-prefix behavior (ticket INF-7891)
- kevin: create a safe rollout plan to expose CB_MAX_MICROBATCH as a per-customer knob (INF-7892)
- maria: patch the config guard and add an alert for rapid microbatch growth (INF-7893)

maria: notes for next oncall: cause likely interaction between continuous batching prefill and KV cache pressure under high concurrency. Immediate fix was caps and throttle; long-term fix: adaptive prefetch + lower memory pressure for KV cache and request-shape signals.

ryan: copying key graphs to incident doc. Will add example logs and the `kubectl` commands used.

asha: customer impact summary to TG: 3 customers experienced intermittent timeouts for up to ~6 minutes during the spike. No data loss. Response: mitigated by config clamp and throttling, monitoring in place.

jordan: handing off to night oncall (kevin) at 23:00 UTC. Kevin, you have the runbook + tickets above.

kevin: taking over. I'll keep watch for recurrence and coordinate postmortem. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: incident-2026-459900 (P1) - resolved via microbatch cap + prefetch reduction. Postmortem owners assigned.

maria: final note - avoid changing any continuous-batching tuning in prod without an A/B on a small pool. Learned the hard way. :sob:

kevin: will do. Closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics trend back up.
